name: Diagnostics
description: Automatic LSP / linter / formatter feedback after Edit/Write. Subscribes to the `tool.didInvoke` chain, detects the diagnostic tools the project already has (tsgo, biome, oxlint: probed from node_modules/.bin + config files, never installed), runs them on the just-written file, and attaches structured findings (the agent renders them into its tool-block chrome) plus a compact `<ma::agent::diagnostics>` note for the model. Type diagnostics use a persistent tsgo LSP (warm 2-3ms/edit) guarded by a circuit breaker; format/lint spawn per call. Defaults to types+format on, lint off. Configure via `plugins.diagnostics` in ~/.minimal-agent/config.jsonc; disable with `plugins.diagnostics.enabled=false` or the env var MINIMAL_AGENT_DIAGNOSTICS_DISABLED=1.
